about: Furniture assemblies mined from the corpus (lab/mine_assemblies.js, lab/select_assemblies.js; 1900 vanilla builds, 9521 clusters). Frame: x along the wall, z into the room from the wall face, y over the floor; yaw against the frame (lab convention). wall: back (stands against one wall), corner (two), none (free-standing; frame of its seed piece). builds: corpus builds holding the same type with the same prefabs. hidden: pieces hidden from the build menu (D-166). q: a piece turned off the vertical keeps its quaternion in the frame (lib/assemblies.js turns it with the facing). info: an item or sign text the source had.
